subtitle: Lesson 4 · Chapter 1: The First Backup Plan

code:
On-prem / VM:
BACKUP DATABASE db_overlook_core
TO DISK = 'D:\Backups\...'
WITH INIT, COMPRESSION;

Azure SQL Database (PaaS):
There is no BACKUP statement to run.
Microsoft already took one, automatically.
caption: Not a gap in the lesson — the real, documented behavior of this platform.

titlePlain: Azure started the chain the moment you

code:
az sql db show \
  --name db-overlook-core \
  --resource-group rg-overlook-dba-capstone \
  --server sql-overlook-capstone \
  --query earliestRestoreDate
caption: A real timestamp (not null) proves a full backup already exists.
